scope.summary: Implement the skin bake pipeline (spec 13.22; GREQ-040, PREQ-034): the full stack - tone derivation, layers, detail normals, wet layers, wrinkle statics, displacement bands - flattens deterministically to portable PBR texture sets per export profile with per-target budget presets and auto-downres, running as a Handshake job with machine-readable bake manifests and Argus preview captures.
acceptance_criteria: Bake job flattens the full skin stack (tone derivation, layer stack, detail normals, wet layers, static wrinkle contributions, displacement bands) to portable PBR sets per export profile (PREQ-034).
Per-target budget presets (4K hero / 2K / 1K) with automatic downres on export (GREQ-040); budget hits and warnings recorded.
Determinism: identical inputs produce byte-identical outputs (hash-pinned); bake manifest rows record maps, sizes, budgets, and warnings machine-readable.
Runs as a Handshake job with leases/cancellation, emits TAILOR_BODY_* SkinBaked events, and persists Argus preview captures of baked results for visual verification.
scope.risk_if_missed: Layered skin that cannot flatten losslessly is trapped in-suite (PREQ-034); without per-target budgets and downres, game exports blow texture memory and offline renders under-deliver - both documented GREQ-040 requirements.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit skin, UVs, and materials

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
